infoCards.title: Production Management
infoCards.description: Comprehensive textile manufacturing and process control system.

infoCards.title: Quality Control
infoCards.description: Advanced quality management system for textile manufacturing.

faqData.question: How does the system manage textile processing?
faqData.answer: Our system provides comprehensive process management including yarn processing, weaving/knitting control, dyeing operations, finishing processes and real-time production monitoring with quality checkpoints.

faqData.question: What quality control features are included?
faqData.answer: The system includes advanced quality testing with fabric inspection, color matching, shade variation tracking, defect classification and detailed quality reporting across all production stages.

faqData.question: Can it handle material planning?
faqData.answer: Yes, our solution manages complete material planning with yarn inventory, dye requirements, chemical consumption tracking and production scheduling optimization.
